messages:
Alex: Quick brainstorm — proposing webinar: "Practical Inference: Benchmarks, Cost, and Failover Patterns". Need a short, punchy hook.
Maria: Love it. Audience = platform + ML engs. Suggest framing as "3 pragmatic strategies" to keep it tactical. :zap:
Jordan: Agree. Benchmarks must be reproducible. Live micro-demo idea: heavy model -> quantized variant fallback, with measurements.
Priya: I can present a customer case: batching + KV cache reduced token cost ~40%. 10–12min slot works for me.
Sam: I'll own the demo. Plan: start on hosted API, then simulate latency spike and failover to a dedicated node. I'll write a clear runbook.
Maria: Early run-of-show draft:
- 00:00 Host intro (Alex) — 2m
- 02:00 Why this matters (Maria) — 3m
- 05:00 Customer case (Priya) — 10m
- 15:00 Benchmarks & methodology (Jordan) — 8m
- 23:00 Live micro-demo (Sam) — 7m
- 30:00 Q&A — 15m
- 45:00 Close + CTA — 2m
Alex: Timeline's tight but doable. Prioritize one clear takeaway per segment + a single slide with cost/latency tradeoffs.
Jordan: For the benchmark pack: include dataset, sequence-length distribution, batch sizes, p50/p95 latencies, token cost, and measurement caveats. No fluff.
Priya: I'll get customer approval on the numbers. ETA: EOD Friday.
Sam: Rehearsal plan: dry run (full) 48h before, tech check 24h before, dress run 2h before. Need volunteers for audience Q&A moderation.
Maria: Proposed rehearsal slots: Tue 10am PT (dry run), Thu 9am PT (tech check).
Alex: +1. OpsBot: rehearsal invites created — https://zoom.example/rr1 (dry run), https://zoom.example/rr2 (tech). Reminder cadence set.
Jordan: Add fallback: if the live demo fails, switch to a recorded screen with annotated logs and the exact curl commands so folks can reproduce. Example snippet:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"small-quant","prompt":"..."}'
Priya: I'll draft a 1-page speaker pre-brief (key message, slide limit, single canonical benchmark table) and share by Wed.
Maria: Action items:
- Alex: finalize title + CTA copy (due Wed)
- Priya: customer slides + pre-brief (due Fri)
- Jordan: benchmark pack + recorded fallback (due Fri)
- Sam: demo runbook + failover script (due Fri)
- OpsBot: create rehearsal invites + reminder schedule
Alex: Keep total slides <12. Fast pace. :rocket:
Sam: I'll also record a 2-minute "what to do if latency spikes" clip we can drop into the demo if needed.
Maria: Great. I'll post the calendar + speaker notes in #marketing and follow up on approvals. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
